title: Barrier height and sphere test
requirement: Barrier at least 48 in high above grade with no opening that passes a 4 in sphere, not climbable

title: Self-closing self-latching gate
requirement: Gate opens away from the pool, self-closes and self-latches, latch release 54 in above grade

title: Doors and windows into the pool area
requirement: Alarm or self-latching device at 54 in on a door with direct pool access; operable windows limited or alarmed

title: Safety cover
requirement: Cover listed to ASTM F1346, supports a 485 lb load; secondary layer only

title: Spa temperature shut-off and signage
requirement: High limit 104 F, emergency shut-off within 5 ft, safety and pregnancy signage, blower timer 15 min

title: Pool depth and diving envelope
requirement: 3 ft shallow minimum, 8 ft maximum without engineered design, 7 ft 6 in to 9 ft under a diving board

title: Floor slopes
requirement: Shallow end no steeper than 1:3, transition no steeper than 1:1 with a cove at the break

title: Entry steps and ladders
requirement: Steps, ladder or sloped entry at the shallow end; two entries for a pool over 30 ft long

title: Deck width and slope
requirement: 4 ft unobstructed deck around the water, sloping about 1/4 in per foot away from pool and building

title: Coping and water edge
requirement: Bullnose or eased coping, 1-2 in overhang, slip resistant, bedded and jointed

title: Turnover periods
requirement: Residential pool 6 h (8 h maximum), spa 30 min, fountain or water feature 1 h

title: Suction outlets and VGB covers
requirement: Two outlets at least 3 ft apart with VGB-listed covers, or an SVRS or vent where duplication is impossible

title: Filter and pump sizing
requirement: Filter at 15 gpm/sq ft sand, 2 gpm/sq ft DE, 0.25 gpm/sq ft cartridge; pump from flow and total dynamic head

title: Skimmer count and placement
requirement: One skimmer per 400-500 sq ft on the windward side, within its 30-50 gpm rating

title: Bather load
requirement: 15 sq ft of water per bather shallow, 20 sq ft deep; post at a public pool

title: Waterfall and water-wall spill
requirement: Q = 3.33 x L(ft) x H(ft)^1.5 cfs; level lip within 1/8 in; 1-2 gpm per inch of width

title: Pond depth liner and aeration
requirement: 24 in minimum for fish, 45 mil EPDM or clay seal, aeration over 18 in, 1:3 banks with coping

title: Water balance targets
requirement: pH 7.2-7.8, free chlorine 1-3 ppm (spa 3-5), alkalinity 80-120 ppm, CYA 30-50 ppm, calcium 200-400 ppm

title: Fountain and water-wall basins
requirement: 6 in of water over the intake, autofill and overflow, splash contained, pump sump accessible

title: Spa water depth and turnover
requirement: 104 F maximum, 30 min turnover, two VGB suction outlets, marked emergency shut-off

title: Equipotential bonding
requirement: Bond shell, steel, coping, deck, fittings, pumps, ladders, rails and water with #8 AWG copper

title: GFCI protection
requirement: GFCI protection for pump motors, underwater luminaires, receptacles and all 125-250 V pool equipment

title: Overhead conductor clearance
requirement: 25 ft horizontal from the water edge up to 750 V; 27 ft for 750 V to 15 kV

title: Pool receptacles
requirement: At least one receptacle between 6 ft and 20 ft from the water, GFCI protected with an in-use cover

title: Pool and spa luminaires
requirement: Listed for pool use, 12 V or GFCI protected, bonded shell and niche, deck box at the required distance

title: Property-line and easement setbacks
requirement: Pool shell, deck and equipment clear of side rear and front setbacks and utility easements; typical 5-10 ft

title: Deck drainage and site grading
requirement: Deck about 2% away from water and building, deck drain or French drain, grade falling away

title: Freeze protection and winterising
requirement: Drain or blow out lines, freeze sensor and low-temperature lockout, listed cover

title: Equipment pad and service access
requirement: Level drained pad, 3 ft clear in front of serviceable equipment, panel working clearance, disconnect in sight

title: Accessible pool entry
requirement: Public pool: pool lift or sloped entry plus an accessible route; spa lift where the ADA applies

title: Inspection and handover pack
requirement: Dimensioned plan, equipment schedule, barrier detail, bonding inspection and water-balance start-up sheet
